extDescription.message: Send YouTube videos to your self-hosted MeTube, and watch its downloads in an overlay player on YouTube.

commandToggleOverlay.message: Play the current YouTube video from MeTube (overlay)

language.description: Language of these messages (BCP 47): numbers, sizes and language names are formatted in it.

errNoAnswer.message: The extension background did not answer.

errUrlMissing.message: Enter the URL of your MeTube instance.

errUrlScheme.message: The MeTube URL must start with http:// or https://.

errUrlCredentials.message: Put the credentials in the username/password fields, not in the URL.

layoutHybridHelp.message: Your defaults in one click; the other choices under “More…”.

layoutFlatHelp.message: Everything in one submenu, under section titles: one hover, one click.

layoutSubmenusHelp.message: One submenu per block: a short menu, every choice one level down.

menuSelectionHeader.message: FOR EACH YOUTUBE LINK IN THE SELECTION

labelAudio.description: What the popup sent with "Audio only" on, in a notification.

optionsTagline.message: Send YouTube links to your self-hosted MeTube, and watch them there from YouTube.

optBaseUrlHint.message: Include the path prefix if MeTube is served under one, e.g. https://example.com/metube.

optAuthHint.message: Sent as HTTP Basic auth (e.g. Traefik basicAuth) with every request. Leave both empty if MeTube isn't behind auth.

optFolderHint.message: Sub-folder of MeTube's download directory. Needs CUSTOM_DIRS on the server (and CREATE_CUSTOM_DIRS for folders that don't exist yet).

optDefaultsHint.message: Used by the popup (whose "Audio only" toggle uses M4A at best quality) and by the player when it adds a video. Every download goes into this folder.

optMenuSubsHint.message: One download per language; set them under Subtitle languages.

optSubtitleLangsHint.message: Language codes, comma-separated. The player loads <video>.<lang>.vtt for each one it finds next to the file. MeTube only writes them with writesubtitles in YTDL_OPTIONS (see the README).

optShortcutHint.message: On a YouTube video page, the shortcut (or the popup's Play button) opens the video from MeTube in an overlay.

optEndScreen.message: When a video ends, offer to delete it from MeTube

optEndScreenHint.message: The player's trash button deletes it at any time. MeTube only erases the file from disk if it runs with DELETE_FILE_ON_TRASHCAN=ask (see the README); otherwise only its entry goes away.

optFooter.message: Saving asks for permission to access your MeTube host. Settings, password included, are stored only in this browser's extension storage.

optBadLangs.message: Not a language code: $1. Use codes like fr, en or pt-BR.

optDenied.message: Access to $1 was not granted, so the extension can't reach MeTube. Click Save or Test again and allow it.

optSavedHttp.message: Saved. Note: over http://, the player on YouTube can't load videos (it needs https://).

optSavedHttpCredentials.message: Saved. Note: over http://, the credentials travel unencrypted, and the player on YouTube can't load videos (it needs https://).

optNotGranted.message: The extension can't access $1 yet: click Save to grant it.

menuExtraSettingsFirst.message: Settings and “Open MeTube” at the top of the submenu

menuExtraPlayer.message: “Play here with MeTube” (on YouTube video pages)

menuExtraToolbar.message: Entries in the extension icon’s right-click menu

menuLangsNone.message: none: add some under “Subtitle languages” below

previewNoToolbar.message: No entries in the extension icon’s menu (turned off above).

previewCaptionLink.message: Right-click on a link: the link is sent.

previewCaptionSelection.message: Right-click on selected text: every YouTube link in it is sent.

previewCaptionPage.message: Right-click on a page (here, a YouTube video page): the page is sent.

previewCaptionVideo.message: Second right-click on the YouTube player: that video is sent.

previewHidden.message: MeTube doesn’t appear here (turned off in “Show MeTube on”).

popupPlayTitle.message: Play this video from MeTube in an overlay

popupCantSend.message: This page can't be sent to MeTube

tagInPlaylistTitle.message: Video link that also carries a playlist ID

popupNoYouTubeLinks.message: No YouTube links found on this page.

errNoLinksInSelection.message: No YouTube links found in the selection.

errNotDownloadable.message: This is not an http(s) URL MeTube can download.

errNoAccess.message: The extension is not allowed to access $1.

errNoAccessSave.message: The extension is not allowed to access $1. Open the options and click Save to grant it.

errNotConfigured.message: MeTube is not configured yet: set its URL in the extension options.

errOpenVideo.message: Open a YouTube video (youtube.com/watch?v=…) to play it from MeTube.

errOutsideMeTube.message: Refusing to fetch a URL outside MeTube.

errNotFinished.message: This video isn't among MeTube's finished downloads anymore.

errNetwork.message: Can't reach $1 ($2). Check the URL and that MeTube is running.

errAuth.message: Authentication failed (401): check the username and password.

errNotFound.message: Not found (404): $1. Check the base URL, including any path prefix.

errNotJson.message: $1 did not answer with JSON. Is the base URL right, or is a login page in the way?

errFileMissing.message: MeTube lists this video as downloaded, but the file isn't on the server anymore (404).

errDeleteFailed.message: MeTube could not delete the download.

sizeUnits.description: Byte units, space-separated, in steps of 1000.

progressScheduled.message: Scheduled: waiting for the premiere or live stream

progressPending.message: Waiting to be started in MeTube

overlayLookingUp.message: Looking up this video in MeTube…

overlayEndHint.message: Del to delete · Esc to close

overlayKeys.message: Space play/pause · ←/→ 5s · F or double-click fullscreen · C subtitles · M mute · Del delete · Esc close

confirmText.message: The file is erased from the server and the video leaves MeTube's list. This can't be undone: to watch it again, it has to be downloaded again.

errNotResponding.message: The extension isn't responding ($1). Reload the page.

errNoAnswerReload.message: The extension didn't answer. Reload the page.

overlayPendingDetail.message: It was added without auto-start: press Start in MeTube.

overlayNotQueued.message: MeTube accepted the video, but it doesn't appear in its queue.

overlayWaitingQueue.message: Waiting for MeTube to queue the video…

overlaySending.message: Not in MeTube yet: sending it…

overlayMixedContent.message: The browser won't load http:// video inside an HTTPS page like YouTube.

overlayMixedContentDetail.message: Serve MeTube over HTTPS (for example with a certificate on Traefik) to use the player.

overlayUnsupported.message: The browser can't play this file: its format or codec isn't supported.

overlayChooseMp4.message: Choosing MP4 as the default video format avoids this.

overlayFileKept.message: Removed from MeTube's list, but the server kept the file.

overlayFileKeptDetail.message: MeTube only erases files when it runs with DELETE_FILE_ON_TRASHCAN=ask (or true): see the README.

overlayErasedFreed.message: File erased from the server · $1 freed.

overlayEndSize.message: It takes $1 on the server. Delete it now?

overlayNoVideoId.message: No YouTube video ID in the page address.

overlayNoYouTubePlayer.message: YouTube's player wasn't found on this page: playback starts from the beginning.
